name: Folder
description: A three-dimensional folder whose flap opens on click; the papers come out, peek when hovered, and can be dropped anywhere by dragging.
interactionNotes: Clicking the folder body opens and closes it; while open, hovering a paper lifts it, a click zooms it, and dragging takes it out of the folder. Clicking outside or Escape closes it. Papers that came out go back by dragging them into the folder again.

props.name: items
props.description: What the folder holds, at most 6 entries. Each entry can be a string, `{ title, description }`, `{ image, title, alt }`, `{ content }`, or a React element.

props.name: children
props.description: Custom documents as children; each child becomes a paper (it takes precedence over `items`).

props.name: mode
props.description: `flap` keeps the folder upright and opens its flap; `book` lays it flat and turns the cover like a book.

props.name: variant
props.description: The folder's material; `glass` makes the flap refractive glass and shows the papers inside through it.

props.name: layout
props.description: Arrangement of the papers when the folder is open: free spread, vertical stack, or tidy row.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the folder; shadows and the light/dark layers are derived from it. Omit it to stay in tune with the mono surface theme; the blue `#3b82f6` is only the accent of the dock's blue slot.

props.name: paperColor
props.description: Color of the papers.

props.name: label
props.description: Text of the tab label; the tab grows to fit the text.

props.name: tabPosition
props.description: Where the tab sits on the top edge (in right-to-left layout, `right` is the start side).

props.name: openOn
props.description: Open on click, or while the pointer is over the folder.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled state; pass `onOpenChange` alongside it.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The folder starts open.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called on every open or close.

props.name: onItemClick
props.description: On clicking a paper, when the folder is open or the paper has been taken out.

props.name: onItemDrop
props.description: On releasing a dragged paper; `inside` says whether it landed inside the folder or outside.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Allow dragging papers out of the folder and dropping them anywhere.

props.name: zoomOnClick
props.description: Clicking a paper brings it close; another click, Escape, or an outside click returns it.

props.name: peek
props.description: On hover the papers peek out a little; in flap mode, the paper under the pointer lifts more.

props.name: intro
props.description: When it comes into view, the papers drop in and the folder closes over them.

props.name: size
props.description: Overall scale of the folder.

props.name: frost
props.description: Amount of glass frosting, 0 to 1; only with `variant='glass'`.

props.name: tilt
props.description: How much the folder tilts toward the pointer, 0 to 1.5.

props.name: speed
props.description: Speed of all animations.

props.name: bounce
props.description: How much the flap/cover/papers bounce when settling, 0 to 1.

props.name: closeOnOutsideClick
props.description: Close on an outside click or Escape.

props.name: theme
props.description: Matches the shadows and focus to a dark or light theme.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class for the root.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline style; it sits after the color variables.

tips: Keep the label short and Persian; the tab grows with the text width and does not overflow the edge.
The paper drawing reads direction from CSS; keep `dir="rtl"` on the page or parent so Persian lines are laid out from the right.
`variant='glass'` gives the best result on WebGL2; without it you still get the same CSS glass with `backdrop-filter`.
Papers can be dragged out and dropped back in; `onItemDrop` tells you which case happened.
Under `prefers-reduced-motion` the intro and the springs calm down; content and accessibility stay untouched.
For narrow cards lower `size`; the spread-open papers need more width than the folder itself.
